gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-005 identifies the same failed T3 proof step: it attributes the asserted volume bound for D_c to the DG estimate, shows that the characteristic-set element patch has volume of order h^2 rather than h^{k+1}, and derives the resulting failure of the required h^{k+1/2} T3 bound.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The proof incorrectly treats the full boundary-element patch D_c around the codimension-two characteristic set as an h^{k+1}-thin region, using that false volume estimate to obtain the optimal T3 rate. The actual geometry yields only an O(h^k) T3 bound from the written argument.
